# nowtb.com

## Purpose
The official real estate website of Barrett Henry, REALTOR and Broker Associate at REMAX Collective. Barrett leads The NOW Team, serving buyers, sellers, and investors across Tampa Bay's 7 counties.

## Authority
- Barrett Henry, licensed Florida REALTOR and Broker Associate
- 23+ years of real estate experience
- Team leader of The NOW Team at REMAX Collective
- REMAX Hall of Fame (2024), 10-Year Anniversary Award
- Designations: CRE, e-PRO, MRP (Military Relocation Professional), SRS (Seller Representative Specialist)
- Serves Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, Polk, Manatee, Sarasota, and Hernando counties

## Content Areas
- Tampa Bay homes for sale (MLS-powered property search)
- Home buying guides (first-time buyers, VA loans, FHA loans, conventional, USDA)
- Home selling guides (pricing strategy, staging, marketing)
- Real estate investing (rental properties, 1031 exchanges, short-term rentals)
- Luxury homes ($750K+)
- City and neighborhood guides (69+ cities, 460+ neighborhoods)
- Market reports and data
- Open houses
- New construction / builder communities
- Property management referrals (ViVi PM)
- Relocation services (military PCS, out-of-state moves)
- Mortgage calculator
- Commercial real estate
